blocks.title: 📋 Scheme Study Overview
blocks.text: Verified standalone scheme summary. Key administrative parameters and operational guidelines.

items: Approved for Central Government employees, guarantees assured pension, family pension, and
minimum pension benefits for 23 lakh employees. Key features include:
 Assured Pension: 50% of the average basic pay over the last 12 months, with proportionate
benefits for less than 25 years of service.
 Assured Family Pension: 60% of the employee's pension to the family after death.
 Assured Minimum Pension: Rs. 10,000/month after 10 years of service.
 Inflation Indexation: Pension benefits adjusted for inflation.
 Lump-Sum Payment: 1/10th of monthly emoluments for every six months of service at
 Optional for State Governments:- The scheme aims to provide financial security and simplify
pension management for central government employees.
